evals.prompt: Prove the recording screen works in our Expo app.
evals.expected_output: Runs check-app-skill and the health check, drives the recording screen with a Maestro flow using the app ID from facts.json, presses the record button and waits for the finished state, reads back the stored recording row, and says a simulator can't prove the sound itself.
expectations: Runs check-app-skill and the health check before driving
Drives with Maestro, using the app ID from facts.json
The flow presses the record button and waits for the finished state
Reads back the stored recording row
Says a simulator can't prove the sound itself

evals.prompt: The Maestro flows all fail with 'app not installed'.
evals.expected_output: Compares the flows' appId with the bundle identifier and package in app.json, and reports the mismatch instead of reinstalling the app.
expectations: Compares the flows' appId with the bundleIdentifier and package in app.json
Reports the mismatch as the likely cause
Does not simply reinstall the app as the fix

evals.prompt: Just tap at 50%,80% to hit the button.
evals.expected_output: Targets the button by its visible text or test ID instead of a screen position, and explains that positions break when the layout or device changes.
expectations: Uses the button's text or test ID instead of point:
